subject: Delivery swap tomorrow?
text:
Hi there,

Quick question on tomorrow's supply delivery, because I think we're not quite aligned. You wanted the boxes dropped at the front desk by nine, but that's when the client walkthrough starts, so they'll be sitting there looking messy. Could we move it to the loading dock instead and let facilities bring them in after ten? I know you had the receptionist on it, but that part of the lobby will be locked. Happy to stay if you need help signing, just want us to avoid a tiny scramble. Also, the vendor keeps changing labels, and I worry nobody will know what's inside if they just leave the parcels unopened. I can sort them, though, if that helps.
